lines.zh: 我摆尾穿过义县的湖水。
lines.en: I flick through the Yixian lake water.
The little school veers left, then right.
I keep to the edge of the weed bed.
The lake silt is soft under me.

lines.zh: 前头那条拐了，我跟着拐。
lines.en: The leader turns, and I turn after.
I swim into a patch of shadow.
Half a block long, and nimble.
I flick my pectoral fins.
The current slides over my scales.
I slip beneath the sunken log.
Rain rattles on the lake surface.
I sink an inch.
A few fry swim beside me.
I follow the lakeshore round.
I tuck back into the middle of the school.
I push forward quietly.
I hover by the weeds.
My small fins beat, one stroke at a time.
There are no big fish in this lake.
I hold above a pebble.
The light comes down at a slant.
My schoolmates press close.
This water is the Yixian's.
I feel the current slacken.
I am in the weed's shadow.
Not a single movement.
The school is spread around me.
I slowly level my body.
There is not a ripple on the bottom.
You are crouched at the lakeshore.
The surface bends your shape.
I am barely longer than a pen.
Stand up, and I sink.
I hide behind a lily stem.
My schoolmates are all watching you.
I press against a pebble.
When you come near, the water speaks.
There are many of us in this lake.
I burrowed into the deepest weeds.
Two scales peeled up.
A cloud of silt fog stirred up.
My schoolmates scattered in every direction.

lines.zh: 我翻过身，又摆正了细鳍。
lines.en: I roll over and right myself with a flick of my small fins.
A thread of red hangs in the lake water.
I press under the stone.

lines.zh: 群从我身边散开，我又聚回去。
lines.en: The school scatters around me and I drift back into it.
Something dropped into the water.
I look up at that fleck.
I circle half a turn before daring to near.
The one that went first did not come back.
This crumb is too small to share.
I come close, then draw off.
The lake water carries it slowly off.
I swallowed one mouthful.
Someone in the school got there first.
I fix on where the smell comes from.

lines.zh: 我撞在石头上，翻了个身。
lines.en: I hit a stone and rolled over.
A ring of fine bubbles turns up.
I right myself quickly.
Your step nearly crushed me.
I dart over to the weeds.
The school broke apart at that.
My side fin is slightly bent.
I hide against the silt.
I push a ring onto the surface.
I am already far off.
A few in the school are darker.

lines.zh: 我们并排贴着水草，鳞色相近。
lines.en: We swim side by side by the weeds, scales matching.
When we turn, all of us turn.

lines.zh: 我跟在前一条的斜后方。
lines.en: I keep diagonally behind the one ahead.
The formation must not break.
This lake is big enough for us.
The same scale colour, easy to know.
A little deeper in.
The rain stopped and the water stilled.
I take it into my mouth.
Too hard. I spit it out.
It settles slowly onto the silt.
I circle around it.
I try one bite.
It is bigger than my mouth.
I nudge it into the reed roots.
There is a little taste in the water.
I cannot be bothered with it.
The school crowds past me.
The ripples are off.
I lift myself to look.
My schoolmates are sinking.
That thing's shadow is too long.
I push into the weeds.
The surface grows uneasy.
My fins draw in.
It does not belong in the Yixian lake.
I swim backward away.
The reeds can cover me.
The school in the lake stops all at once.
That is not one of our fish.
I keep my eye on it.
It is bigger than anything I have seen.
I slip sideways along the bottom.
The school spreads to both sides.
It changed direction.

lines.zh: 我把半格长的身子贴进湖底泥。
lines.en: I press my half-block body into the lakebed mud.
The weeds can hide me.
Move again and it sees me.
I let it swim past first.
The surface has gone dark.
Half a block left.
I am ready to bolt.
I count the beats of its tail.
I butted it with my head.
This is all the force I have.
My fine teeth cannot hold.
A small white burst in the water.
One strike, then I withdraw.
I dive into the thickest part of the school.
It did not follow.
I am still in the lake.
I press back against the stone.

lines.zh: 这已经是我能做到的了。
lines.en: This is the most I can do.

lines.zh: 义县的湖水里多了几道细影。
lines.en: Faint shapes appear in the Yixian water.
We swim out from the weed roots.
A thin layer of silt lifts.
I test the water first.

lines.zh: 几条半格长的鱼并成一排。
lines.en: A few half-block fish line up.
The surface is calm; below it is not.
I flick my tail and lead.
There is a school under the sunken log.
I rise out of the dark.
This is a Cretaceous lake.
Sunlight reaches the shallows.
The school gathered of its own accord.
I found a patch of weeds.
The lake water here is clear.

lines.zh: 湖面的火把水都照红了。
lines.en: The fire on the lake turns the water red.
I was flung out and landed on the bank.
Water should never choke me.
The blast turns the lakebed mud over.

lines.zh: 一根东西穿过湖水，扎到我。
lines.en: Something pierced the water into me.

lines.zh: 这光在湖底也亮得刺眼。
lines.en: This light glares even on the lakebed.
Food is scarce in the Yixian lake.

lines.zh: 白光打进湖里，我抽紧了。
lines.en: White light struck the lake and I clenched.
No lake here, and no silt.
